card.name: Linking words before medical condition terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "to", "or", "a" and "order" in medical warning or guidance text. They come just before a symptom, illness or condition is named.

modes.label: "or" joining conditions
modes.description: The word "or" after "untreated" or "suicidality", right before a second condition or symptom.
modes.example: and untreated<< or>> inadequately treated extrapyramidal

modes.label: Purpose or condition lead-in
modes.description: "to", "order" or "a" in a phrase that leads into a safety action or a medical condition.
modes.example: All individuals have the right to leave an athletic site in order<< to>> seek a safe structure if the person feels
